nodes.text: The third case of the HMPV virus has been detected in India, in a 2-month-old baby in Ahmedabad. The child is currently receiving treatment in a private hospital in the city. Reportedly, the state government is expected to issue guidelines regarding the HMPV virus on Monday. https://t.co/naCXKxdgoD
